free_text: A repeat biopsy is recommended because the patient has a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the left mid-gland peripheral zone and a rising PSA trend, indicating disease progression. Although the prior biopsy grade and surveillance status were not recorded, the presence of a PI-RADS 4 finding and rising PSA trajectory necessitates further histological clarification. The evidence converged on the need for a repeat biopsy to establish the current pathological status.
